papers.title: On the Optimization of Deep Networks: Implicit Acceleration by Overparameterization
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title and authors Sanjeev Arora,Nadav Cohen,Elad Hazan; footer arXiv1802.06509v2[cs.LG]11Jun2018. Versioned18pageoriginal preprint.
findings: Pp1-3: depth through linear matrix factorization can change optimization without changing represented linear function class. This directly precedes any generic claim that removable training degrees of freedom can help optimization.

P4 Theorem1/eqs6-10 assumes continuous gradient dynamics and balanced initial adjacent-layer Gram matrices; finite-step update is an approximation. P5 describes induced PSD preconditioning, not a theorem for arbitrary extra parameters.
Current normalized nonlinear quantum-state/effect model, disk gate and AdamW do not meet that theorem. No acceleration/generalization conclusion is transferred.
limitations: Only pp1-5 read and p4 rendered. AppendixA proof details, later claims/experiments and original implementation not audited. No new theorem or novelty clearance.

papers.title: ExpandNets: Linear Over-parameterization to Train Compact Convolutional Networks
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title and authors Shuxuan Guo,Jose M.Alvarez,Mathieu Salzmann; arXiv1811.10495v5[cs.CV]14Apr2021; printed NeurIPS2020 proceedings line. Versioned23pagepreprint, not silently relabeled publisherVOR.
findings: Pp1-3: train expanded consecutive linear layers inside nonlinear compact networks, then contract algebraically for inference. Generic train-time expansion with inference removal is already known.
P4 eqs2,4 show convolution/fully-connected matrix-product folding. Exact algebraic contraction differs from setting one nonlinear quantum score channel to zero after training.
Inspected original supports a prior-art collision for the broad training-only-freedom story, not whole-model identity or an explanation of the Q-RMEA result.
limitations: Only pp1-4 read/p4rendered. Numerical empirical outcomes and later/supplementary proofs not reproduced or certified; current model not ExpandNet and no new novelty claim.
